about: RS-04 leg motor thermal model (issue #194); generated by sim/motor_thermal.py: regenerate, never edit

kt_nm_per_arms.src: manual 1.3 item 11 and spec book: torque constant at the output, N m per A rms

r_line_ohm.src: spec book RS04 page: line (phase-to-phase) resistance 0.16 ohm +-10 %; taken at 25 C (the book states no temperature: assumed)

i_noload_arms.src: spec book: no-load current 0.7 A rms at 200 rpm (the manual says 2 A rms: the range); drag torque = kt x I0 at any speed (friction + iron)

p_standby_w.src: manual 2.1: standby <= 40 mA at 48 V (1.9 W); the driver's own idle loss

r_driver_ohm.src: assumed: the drive stage's conduction, 4 mohm per phase leg (3 x I^2 x R)

winding_limit_c.src: manual 1.3 item 13: the firmware's calculated winding limit ("the constraint temperature; the actual temperature is 180 C"); its thermistor fault is also 145

winding_target_c.src: this model's margin: 10 K under insulation Class B (130 C, manual 1.2 item 11), 25 K under the firmware's 145 C cut

stall_rated_nm.src: manual 1.3 item 14: the stall table's rated (continuous) row; the firmware's locked-rotor protection (fault bit 14) trips sooner than the heat alone (section 2)

stall_factor.src: a held motor's hottest phase carries the peak current, I_pk^2 = 2 I_rms^2; the manual's text says 1.414, its stall table (40 / 28.5)^2 = 1.97: 2.0 taken

mass_kg.src: owner 2026-11-03: four boxed motors 7 kg, about 1.51 kg each with leads; the spec book's 1510 +- 20 g (the manual says 1420). Not a ledger change

c_mix_j_per_kgk.src: assumed mix: 40 % aluminium (900), 45 % steel (470), 10 % copper (385), 5 % magnets (450)

eps_case.src: assumed: an anodised or painted housing

can_air_factor.src: a multiplier on the case's convection and radiation: 1 until the bench fit (--fit) measures it

rear_cover_d_m.src: manual 1.1 drawing: rear cover O94 x 13.2

face_bore_d_m.src: CAD: the hip frame's 61812 bore (O78 + 0.6), inside the motor's face annulus

face_bolts.src: CAD / manual: 10 x M4 on O106 (clearance O4.5 each)

rating_a.src: spec book: rated 40 N m measured at 50 rpm on a 345 x 345 mm aluminium plate (manual 1.2: GB/T 30549-2014, 25 C ambient; the manual says 100 rpm)

rating_b.src: spec book: the thermal-equilibrium T-N table on a 220 x 200 mm aluminium plate, 35.5 N m at 40 rpm

rating_b_curve.src: spec book: the rest of that table (validation, not fitted)

overload_table.src: manual 1.3 item 13: N m and seconds to the limit at 50 rpm, 345 x 345 plate, 25 C (from cold: assumed). Rows >= 115 N m are the drive's peak-current timer, not heat: not fitted

stall_table.src: manual 1.3 item 14: stalled, N m and seconds to the protection

test_plate_t_m.src: assumed: the test plates' thickness (GB/T 30549-2014 not read)

h_contact_metal.src: assumed: dry bolted aluminium faces, light pressure (Madhusudana, Thermal Contact Conductance: 1-5 kW/m2K)

h_contact_polymer.src: assumed: a printed face on the motor's machined face under 10 x M4

pla.src: catalog pla (density, max service 54 C); k 0.13 W/mK and cp assumed (printed PLA 0.12-0.20); the face limit 50 C is the owner's (PLA softens at about 55-60 C)

pa6cf.src: catalog pa6-cf (density, max service 164 C); k 0.4 W/mK assumed (printed CF nylon 0.25-0.8); face limit 80 C assumed: the bolted, preloaded joint creeps long before the HDT

gap_pad.src: assumed: a 2.5 mm silicone gap pad of 3 W/mK compressed to the 2.0 mm gap (k swept 1.5-6)

k_air.src: textbook: air at about 40 C, W/mK

web_t_m.src: CAD fivebar.Y['frame']: the hip frame's web, y -25.1..-1.0

flange_len_m.src: CAD: web (y -25.1) to the mount plane (fivebar.Y['centre_plane'] -82.3)

flange_x_m.src: CAD fivebar.FLANGE_X: each flange 190 mm long, half of it per motor

rear_gap_m.src: CAD: the rear cover (y -80.3) to the cheek's or the stand's face (y -82.3)

rear_overlap_m2.src: CAD: the O94 rear cover face where the cheek (x <= 92) is behind it, the motor at x 75 (a circle minus its segment beyond the chord at 17 mm)

can_side_exposed.src: assumed: the share of the O120 side in free air; a printed frame's flanges cover its top and bottom 3.5 mm away, a flat plate leaves it open

web_leg_face_m2.src: CAD (approximate): per motor, the web's leg-side face from the hub's O80 to the frame's half outline (95 x 158 mm), less the stop bosses

plate.src: option C, assumed: a SendCutSend 1/4 in 6061-T6 plate the web's outline (190 x 158 mm), the motors on its inner face, held off the cheek by six O16 6061 spacers 57.2 mm long at the frame's six M5 positions (x 0, +-83; z +-70) on through M5 screws

plate_black.src: option E, assumed: black anodising eps 0.85 (textbook 0.8-0.9); the six spacers G10/FR4 (k 0.3 W/mK through the laminate) instead of aluminium, a thermal break to the cheek

body_parts_kg.src: CAD docs/body-sections.md: 2 x 492 g cheeks (5052 3/16 in), the tray 753 g (5052 1/8 in), the belly 247 g (6061 0.100 in)

body_surfaces.src: CAD dimensions (docs/body-frame.md; length: a vertical face's height, a horizontal one's area / perimeter, Incropera 9.30-9.32); the open shares (35 %, 60 %, 30 %) assumed: the motors and frames cover the cheeks' outer faces, the gap between them is 31 mm and closed, the battery bay hangs under the belly

tray_top_m2.src: CAD: the tray's top in the body's air (70 % open: the pallet, the power plate on posts)

body_air.src: exports/body/thermal/hand_model.json (cad/body_thermal.py, P1 deck): the cooler's inlet 2.59 K over the room at 21.1 m3/h (m cp 6.84 W/K); D61's budget 3 K

ambient_hot_c.src: assumed: a warm day (the RS-04 allows -20..50 C)

drive_fx_g.src: assumed: driving and balancing as a fore-aft force at the tyre of 0.25 g rms of the leg's load

jump_period_s.src: the owner's case: a jump every 10 s

loads.basis: quasi-static: sim.leg_rig.pin_forces on cad.fivebar.stance(h), the axle carrying the leg's design load less its wheel (D71: 18.75 kg a leg); front and rear are the two hip motors (the five-bar has no knee motor)

stand.title: Standing at the design stance (300 mm leg)

crouch.title: Holding the lowest controlled crouch (185 mm leg, D71)

drive.title: Driving and balancing at 260 mm: 0.25 g rms fore-aft at the tyre (assumed)

jumps.title: A jump every 10 s (the rig's jump at the 60 N m cap), standing between

jump.source: exports/leg/rig-results.json scenarios.jump (18.75 kg, the 60 N m cap)

rig_stand_check.note: the rig's stand_up ends holding at 300 mm; this model's figure is the higher (conservative)

bench.source: exports/motor-day/derating.json: the PLA cap (pla_cap_nm) and the motor-day stand-up's peak motor torque (stand_runs.stand_up); the stand's 11.89 kg at the foot

calibration.bound: emissivity at its bound: the two ratings are not met together

options.A_pla: A. Printed PLA hip frame (the bench build): 24.1 mm web, flanges to the cheek
options.B_pa6cf: B. Printed PA6-CF hip frame (the current design), as A
options.C_al_plate: C. Flat 1/4 in 6061-T6 plate in the frame's place, on six O16 6061 spacers to the 5052 cheek
options.D_pa6cf_pad: D. PA6-CF frame as B, plus a 3 W/mK gap pad from each rear cover to the cheek (2.0 mm gap)
options.E_al_plate_black_iso: E. The 6061 plate of C, black anodised (eps 0.85), on G10 spacers: its heat to the open air, not into the body

recommendation.rule: passes: the winding at or under the target and the face at or under its material's limit; of those, the least heat into the body's air
